title: Tau project file
description: What a repository checks in about itself for Tau, at .tau/project.json. See docs/project-file.md.

$schema.description: Where an editor finds this schema.

workspaceMode.description: Where a new thread runs: the checkout it was started from, or a worktree of its own. Read by Workspace Kit.

worktreeDirectory.description: Where worktrees go: a directory path such as "~/.tau/worktrees"; beside the repository when absent. Read by Workspace Kit.

worktreeSubmodules.description: How a new worktree initializes git submodules: all of them, only the ones this repository declares, or none (leave them to a setup script). The Source control setting wins when it names a value. Read by Workspace Kit from the branch being checked out.

runOnWorktreeCreate.description: The old spelling of a setup script: runs once in every new worktree and holds the thread until it exits. Prefer a script with "runOnWorktreeCreate": true.

scripts.description: Quick actions: one button above the composer and one script.<id>.run command per entry, in this order. Read by Project Scripts.

id.description: Stable id; the command is script.<id>.run. Defaults to the name in lowercase with dashes.

name.description: Label of the button and the command.

command.description: Shell command, run with /bin/sh -c in the thread's checkout (its worktree, if it has one). TAU_PROJECT_ROOT and TAU_SCRIPT_ID are set; a worktree setup also gets TAU_WORKTREE_PATH.

keybinding.description: A chord in the workbench's spelling: modifiers (mod, ctrl, shift, alt, meta) and a key joined by +; mod is Cmd on macOS and Ctrl elsewhere.

runOnWorktreeCreate.description: Run once in every worktree Workspace Kit creates for a new thread.

async.description: Only with runOnWorktreeCreate: false holds the new thread until the script exits; true lets it start while the script runs.

previewUrl.description: Page the script serves. The run card gets a preview button, and the preview opens once the URL answers.

autoOpenPreview.description: Open previewUrl by itself once it answers; false leaves it to the card's button.
